process_observation.limitations: Command-line observation of Python processes only; API server presence is separate and does not prove loaded source revision or absence of hidden in-process work.

application_rules: Use exact manifest union only; never copy an entire workspace directory.
Archive exact main baseline bytes after Root approval before replacement.
Compare pre228 baseline to final237 bytes directly, not patch sequence assumptions.
Recheck every main before SHA/new-path absence immediately before any approved apply.
Tests are separate validation sources, not production runtime files.
Historical source-code fixture and input supplement are test-only inputs outside the apply union.
